q: The capacity-achieving codes for memoryless sources in the Shannon sense are related to ergodic theory by the AEP. The typical set Tε^n has the properties:
opts: It has probability → 1, contains ≈ 2^{nH} strings each with probability ≈ 2^{-nH}, and can be described in ≈ nH bits
It equals the support of P^n
exp: AEP typical set: P(T^n_ε) → 1, |T^n_ε| ≈ 2^{nH}, each x ∈ T^n_ε has P(x) ≈ 2^{-nH}. Encoding only typical sequences achieves rate H with vanishing error—the operational meaning of entropy as minimum description length for i.i.d. sources.
